column4: Seamless tileable texture of very dark bottle-green leather from the top of a 1990s executive desk, fine natural pebbled grain, even flat lighting, no objects, no stitching, no seams, no vignette, a low-colour hand-painted video game texture from 1998

A 32x32 Windows 95 application icon in exactly the same pixel-art style as the reference icon, the same black outline, palette and shading, simple and readable at 32 pixels, centred on a plain white background: a big high-backed boss's office armchair in dark green leather with gold studs, seen from the front at a slight angle, nothing else in the picture
